title: Ethiopian Teff Porridge Sweet
community: All of Ethiopia — the sweetened teff porridge as dessert
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Sweet Teff Porridge — teff flour cooked into a smooth, slightly thick porridge, sweetened with honey and enriched with a touch of kibbeh. The sweetened version of the morning porridge becomes Ethiopia's most nutritious dessert — served warm in small bowls.
longDesc: Sweet teff porridge occupies the space between breakfast and dessert in Ethiopian food culture — teff's natural earthiness, sweetened with honey and enriched with kibbeh, produces a warm dessert of remarkable nutritional density.
steps: Whisk teff flour into simmering water gradually.
Cook over medium heat, stirring continuously, 15—18 minutes until thick.
Stir in honey, kibbeh, and cardamom.
chefTips: Teff porridge thickens quickly — work fast.
The kibbeh adds richness that transforms it from breakfast to dessert.
cookingScience: See ETH001 for teff grain science.
sustainabilityTips: Teff — Ethiopia's most indigenous and nutritious grain.
healthBenefits: Highest iron content of any grain.
The most nutritious warm dessert possible.
culturalNote: Sweet teff porridge is the dessert that Ethiopian mothers serve to children and elderly — warm, gentle, deeply nourishing, and completely satisfying. It is the taste of care in Ethiopian food.
